newsitem.title: USA: US EIA data shows heating fuel stocks rebuild.
newsitem.headline: US EIA data shows heating fuel stocks rebuild.

text.p: Data released this week showed a substantial improvement in the winter heating fuels stocks situation, but inventory levels will remain "very weather-sensitive," the chief of the U S. Energy Information Administration said Friday.
"There has been substantial progress in getting inventories closer to last year's levels," EIA administrator Jay Hakes said at a news briefing.

A warm December lessened the usual draw on heating fuel stocks, but the warmer U.S. weather was partially offset by cold weather in Europe, "and so there has not been a lot of price relief at this point," Hakes said.
Distillate stocks have been rebuilt to 6.1 percent below last year's level, propane to 2.6 percent below and natural gas to 2.5 percen below, Hakes said.
But he said, "This does not mean we are out of the woods because these numbers are very weather-sensitive."
Hakes said he expected uncertainty to remain in the markets which he said, "We'll have to track carefully."
